data.name: ListSeparator
data.comment: Goes between names in a list, before the last one ("A, B and C"). Keep the space after the comma if your language uses one.

data.name: ListAnd
data.comment: The last two names of a list: "A and B", or "A, B and C". {0} = the names before the last one, {1} = the last name.

data.name: GoodMorning
data.comment: Greeting at the top of the shelf, 5:00–12:00. Short, friendly, no punctuation.

data.name: GoodAfternoon
data.comment: Greeting at the top of the shelf, 12:00–18:00.

data.name: GoodEvening
data.comment: Greeting at the top of the shelf, 18:00–5:00.

data.name: Today
data.comment: When something happened. Stands alone or before a time ("Today, 20:14"). Sentence case.

data.name: Yesterday
data.comment: When something happened. Stands alone or before a time ("Yesterday, 20:14").

data.name: DaysAgo
data.comment: When something happened, 2–6 days ago. {0} = number of days (2–6).

data.name: DayAndTime
data.comment: When a session started. {0} = "Today", "Yesterday", a weekday or a date; {1} = the time, in the user's format.

data.name: UnderAMinute
data.comment: A session shorter than one minute. Keep it as short as "{0} min".

data.name: Minutes
data.comment: A duration in minutes. {0} = minutes. Use your language's usual short unit, as in Windows.

data.name: HoursMinutes
data.comment: A duration. {0} = hours, {1} = minutes (may have a leading zero: "05"). Use the short units Windows uses.

data.name: Hours
data.comment: A duration in whole hours. {0} = hours.

data.name: Seconds
data.comment: A delay in seconds. {0} = seconds. Short unit.

data.name: Instantly
data.comment: Choice for how soon Game Shelf hides after a game starts: immediately, no delay.

data.name: SizeGb
data.comment: A size on disk. {0} = the number, already in the user's number format. Keep your language's symbol for gigabytes (French: Go).

data.name: SizeMb
data.comment: A size on disk. {0} = the number. Keep your language's symbol for megabytes (French: Mo).

data.name: XboxApp
data.comment: Name of Microsoft's Xbox app for Windows, as Windows shows it in your language.

data.name: SourceOther
data.comment: Filter chip and label for games added by hand or from desktop shortcuts, not from a launcher. Plural sense: "other games".

data.name: On
data.comment: State of a setting or a choice in a list (Game mode: On / Off). Use the word Windows Settings uses for a switch that is on.

data.name: Off
data.comment: State of a setting or a choice in a list. Use the word Windows Settings uses for a switch that is off.

data.name: Never
data.comment: Last played: the game was never played. Stands alone in a table cell.

data.name: None
data.comment: Count of hidden games when there are none. Stands alone on a settings card's second line.

data.name: Play
data.comment: Button that starts the game. Also the menu item and the hint on a cover. A verb, imperative, one word if possible.

data.name: PlayGame
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a Play button. {0} = the game's name.

data.name: Details
data.comment: Button and menu item that open a game's details page. Also its tooltip.

data.name: Settings
data.comment: The app's settings page: button, page title and tray menu item. Use the word Windows uses for "Settings".

data.name: Favorite
data.comment: Tooltip of the star on a cover, and the controller hint for marking a favorite. A noun.

data.name: Close
data.comment: Button that asks a running program to close (like clicking its X). Also the controller hint that closes the panel. A verb.

data.name: Cancel
data.comment: Button in a dialog. Use Windows' standard word.

data.name: Ok
data.comment: Button that dismisses a message. Use Windows' standard word.

data.name: Dismiss
data.comment: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the X that closes a card or message. A verb.

data.name: Change
data.comment: Drop-down button on a settings card that opens a menu of choices (cover image, program). A verb.

data.name: Reset
data.comment: Button that removes the custom launch options. A verb.

data.name: Done
data.comment: Last button of the setup steps and of the uninstall steps. Means "finished".

data.name: More
data.comment: Drop-down button with the launcher filters that don't fit in the row. Short: ~8 characters.

data.name: MoreActions
data.comment: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the "…" button with more actions.

data.name: GameModeOnToolTip
data.value: Game mode is on. Select to turn it off.
data.comment: Tooltip of the shelf header's Game mode button, which is shown only while Game mode is on; selecting it turns Game mode off. "Game mode" is the feature's name.

data.name: Back
data.comment: Button that goes to the previous setup step. A verb or "Back" as Windows uses it.

data.name: WithEsc
data.comment: Tooltip of a back button. {0} = where it goes ("Back to settings"). Keep the key name as on your keyboard (French: Échap).

data.name: BackToGames
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the back arrow that returns to the shelf.

data.name: BackToSettings
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the back arrow that returns to the Settings page.

data.name: Checking
data.comment: Shown while the app is checking something (engine, anti-cheat requirements). Keep the ellipsis.

data.name: NotPlayed
data.comment: Total playtime for a period with no play. Stands alone, as a large number would.

data.name: NotPlayedLower
data.comment: A day or week with no playtime, after a label: "Monday: not played". Starts in lower case.

data.name: ChooseProgram
data.comment: Menu item that opens a file picker to choose an .exe. Keep the ellipsis.

data.name: Games
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the cover grid and the list of games.

data.name: GameCount
data.comment: Number of games, plural form. {0} = number.

data.name: GameCountOne
data.comment: Number of games, singular form (also used for 0 in French). {0} = number.

data.name: ShelfName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the main page with the cover grid ("the shelf").

data.name: Dot
data.comment: Two short facts on one line, separated by a middle dot. {0} and {1} = the facts. Keep the middle dot.

data.name: LabelValue
data.comment: A label and its value ("Monday: 2 h"). {0} = label, {1} = value. Follow your language's spacing before the colon.

data.name: FooterHides
data.comment: Footer hint under the grid: Game Shelf hides itself as soon as a game starts.

data.name: FooterHidesAfter
data.value: Hides {0} s after a game starts
data.comment: Footer hint under the grid. {0} = seconds until Game Shelf hides after a game starts.

data.name: FooterComesBack
data.comment: Footer hint. {0} = the hide hint before it ("Hides when a game starts"). Game Shelf comes back when the game closes.

data.name: SearchGames
data.comment: Placeholder and screen-reader name of the search box.

data.name: SearchCountOne
data.comment: Placeholder of the search box, singular. {0} = number of games on the shelf.

data.name: SearchCount
data.comment: Placeholder of the search box, plural. {0} = number of games on the shelf.

data.name: EmptyNoGames
data.value: No games found yet. Installed games from your launchers appear here.
data.comment: Shown on an empty shelf when no games were found at all. Two short sentences.

data.name: EmptyNoMatch
data.comment: Shown when the search finds nothing. {0} = what the user typed. Use your language's quotation marks.

data.name: EmptyRecent
data.comment: Shown in the Recent filter before any game was played from Game Shelf.

data.name: EmptyFavorites
data.comment: Shown in the Favorites filter when there are no favorites.

data.name: EmptyStore
data.comment: Shown when a launcher filter has no games (e.g. all hidden).

data.name: FilterAll
data.comment: Filter chip: all games. Short, ~8 characters.

data.name: FilterFavorites
data.comment: Filter chip: favorite games only. Short.

data.name: FilterRecent
data.comment: Filter chip: recently played games. Short, an adjective or noun.

data.name: Filter
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the row of filter chips.

data.name: MoreLaunchers
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the "More" button with further launcher filters.

data.name: SortMostPlayed
data.comment: Sort order in the sort menu.

data.name: SortName
data.comment: Sort order in the sort menu: alphabetical. Keep "A–Z" (with an en dash) unless your language writes it differently.

data.name: SortRecentlyAdded
data.comment: Sort order in the sort menu: newest additions first.

data.name: SortSize
data.comment: Sort order, and the "Size on disk" label on a game's details. Use Windows Explorer's term.

data.name: SortRecentlyPlayed
data.comment: Sort order in the sort menu: last played first.

data.name: SortCurrent
data.comment: Tooltip of the sort button. {0} = the current sort order ("Most played").

data.name: FavoritesFirst
data.comment: Check item in the sort menu: favorites always come first.

data.name: ContinuePlaying
data.comment: Small heading above the last played game in the top card.

data.name: SpotlightContinue
data.comment: Tab in the top card's switch (next to "This week"). Short, one word if possible.

data.name: WelcomeBack
data.comment: Small heading in the top card, shown once after a session ends.

data.name: WelcomeDetail
data.comment: Under "Welcome back". {0} = length of the session just played, {1} = playtime this week. Both like "1 h 12 min".

data.name: WelcomeMilestone
data.comment: Quiet milestone under "Welcome back". {0} = hours played in total (10, 50, 100, …), {1} = game name.

data.name: ThisWeek
data.comment: Tab in the top card's switch, and the start of the weekly summary line.

data.name: WeekGamesMost
data.comment: Weekly summary. {0} = "3 games", {1} = name of the most played game.

data.name: WeekMostPlayed
data.comment: Tooltip of the weekly summary. {0} = game name, {1} = its playtime this week.

data.name: PlaytimeThisWeek
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the bar chart of the week.

data.name: TopCard
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the switch between "Continue" and "This week".

data.name: PinOpen
data.comment: Tooltip of the pin button in the flyout: keep the panel open when clicking elsewhere.

data.name: Unpin
data.comment: Tooltip of the pin button while pinned: let the panel close again when clicking elsewhere.

data.name: GameMode
data.comment: Name of the app's own feature that optimizes Windows while a game runs. Not Windows' "Game Mode"; keep the two distinct.

data.name: GameModeNeedsUpdateMenu
data.comment: Menu item: Game mode's admin helper must be updated first.

data.name: GameModeSettingsMenu
data.comment: Menu item that opens the Game mode page. Keep the ellipsis.

data.name: FreeUpSpaceMenu
data.comment: Menu item that opens the page to plan which games to uninstall. Keep the ellipsis.

data.name: AddGameMenu
data.comment: Menu item that opens a file picker to add a game by hand. Keep the ellipsis.

data.name: AddGame
data.comment: Button that opens a file picker to add a game by hand, and that picker's title.

data.name: RefreshLibrary
data.comment: Menu item and button: look for newly installed or removed games again.

data.name: ClearSearch
data.comment: Button that empties the search box.

data.name: ImportShortcuts
data.comment: Button and page title: move game shortcuts from the desktop into Game Shelf.

data.name: HelperBarTitle
data.comment: Title of a notice on the shelf: Game mode's admin helper is out of date.

data.name: HelperBarMessage
data.value: Its admin helper is from an older version. Windows asks for permission once.
data.comment: Text of that notice. "Its" = Game mode's. Windows will show one permission prompt (UAC).

data.name: UpdateEllipsis
data.comment: Button that updates Game mode's helper; Windows then asks for permission. Keep the ellipsis.

data.name: PadHintsName
data.value: Controller: A play, X details, Y favorite, B close, Menu settings
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the controller button hints. Keep A, X, Y, B and Menu as on an Xbox controller.

data.name: OpenInstallFolder
data.comment: Menu item, button name and tooltip: open the game's folder in File Explorer.

data.name: StorePage
data.comment: Menu item and link: open the game's page in its online store.

data.name: VerifyFiles
data.comment: Menu item for Steam games: Steam checks the game's files and repairs them. Use Steam's own wording in your language if you know it.

data.name: UninstallInSteam
data.comment: Menu item for Steam games: Steam asks before it uninstalls. Keep the ellipsis.

data.name: AddFavorite
data.comment: Menu item and button name: mark the game as a favorite.

data.name: RemoveFavorite
data.comment: Menu item and button name: unmark the game as a favorite.

data.name: HideFromShelf
data.comment: Menu item and link: hide the game from the shelf (it can be shown again in Settings).

data.name: DetailsFor
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the details button on a cover. {0} = game name.

data.name: UninstallHintSteam
data.comment: Instruction while uninstalling. {0} = game name. Steam shows its own confirmation.

data.name: UninstallHintGog
data.value: In GOG Galaxy, open the menu next to Play and choose Uninstall.
data.comment: Instruction while uninstalling a GOG game. "Play" and "Uninstall" are GOG Galaxy's own buttons: use the words GOG Galaxy shows in your language.

data.name: UninstallHintLauncher
data.value: Find {0} in your {1} library and choose Uninstall.
data.comment: Instruction while uninstalling. {0} = game name, {1} = launcher name ("EA app"). "Uninstall" is the launcher's own menu item.

data.name: UninstallHintApps
data.value: Find {0} in Settings › Apps and choose Uninstall.
data.comment: Instruction while uninstalling. {0} = game name. Use Windows' names for Settings, Apps and Uninstall in your language.

data.name: TheLauncher
data.comment: Used as {1} in "Find {0} in your {1} library" when the launcher's name is unknown. Lower case, a noun.

data.name: DetailName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a game's details page.

data.name: BackToGamesEsc
data.comment: Tooltip of the back arrow. Keep the key name as on your keyboard (French: Échap).

data.name: ShowAntiCheatDetails
data.comment: Tooltip of the anti-cheat label in a game's header: opens the anti-cheat card.

data.name: InstallFolderNotFound
data.comment: Tooltip of the disabled folder button: the game's folder doesn't exist on disk.

data.name: Playtime
data.comment: Label above the total time played, on a game's details. A noun.

data.name: LastPlayed
data.comment: Label above when the game was last played, on a game's details.

data.name: Activity
data.comment: Heading of the playtime chart and recent sessions on a game's details.

data.name: ChartPeriod
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the switch between "8 weeks" and "12 months".

data.name: EightWeeks
data.comment: Tab of the playtime chart: show the last 8 weeks.

data.name: TwelveMonths
data.comment: Tab of the playtime chart: show the last 12 months.

data.name: RecentSessions
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the list of recent play sessions.

data.name: NoSessions
data.value: No sessions yet. Playtime is recorded when you start the game here.
data.comment: Shown on a game's details before any session was recorded. "here" = from Game Shelf.

data.name: SessionClosedNormally
data.comment: Tooltip of a check mark next to a past session: the game exited without an error.

data.name: SessionStartFailed
data.comment: Mark next to a past session: the game exited with an error within seconds of starting.

data.name: SessionClosedUnexpectedly
data.comment: Mark next to a past session: the game exited with an error code, but Windows recorded no crash.

data.name: SessionCrashed
data.comment: Mark next to a past session: Windows recorded a crash. Past tense.

data.name: SessionDetailsName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the "Details" link of a past session. {0} = when it started ("Yesterday, 20:14").

data.name: ChartMonthsName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the playtime chart in months view.

data.name: ChartWeeksName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the playtime chart in weeks view.

data.name: PeriodMonths
data.value: in the last 12 months · this month {0}
data.comment: Line under the chart's total. {0} = playtime this month, or "none yet". Starts in lower case: it follows the total.

data.name: PeriodWeeks
data.value: in the last 8 weeks · this week {0}
data.comment: Line under the chart's total. {0} = playtime this week, or "none yet". Starts in lower case.

data.name: NoneYet
data.comment: {0} in "this week {0}" when nothing was played yet. Lower case.

data.name: WeekOf
data.comment: Tooltip of a weekly bar. {0} = the Monday's date in short form ("Sep 14").

data.name: ThisGame
data.comment: Heading of the settings that apply only to this game.

data.name: HideDelay
data.comment: Card title and choice box: how soon Game Shelf hides after this game starts.

data.name: DefaultChoice
data.comment: First entry of a per-game choice: use the app's general setting. {0} = that setting ("10 s", "off").

data.name: Default
data.comment: Summary of launch options when nothing is changed. Stands alone.

data.name: GameModeForGame
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the per-game Game mode choice.

data.name: GameModeForGameToolTip
data.value: Set up in Settings › Game mode
data.comment: Tooltip of the per-game Game mode card. "Settings › Game mode" = the app's own settings page, not Windows'.

data.comment: Card title: the picture shown on the game's cover.

data.name: ChangeCover
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the button that changes the cover image.

data.name: ChooseImage
data.comment: Menu item that opens a file picker for an image. Keep the ellipsis.

data.name: UseDefault
data.comment: Menu item: go back to the cover the app found or generated.

data.name: CoverCustom
data.comment: State of the cover card: the user picked their own image.

data.name: CoverSteam
data.comment: State of the cover card: the image comes from Steam.

data.name: CoverGenerated
data.comment: State of the cover card: the app made a cover from the game's icon or initials.

data.name: PickCoverTitle
data.comment: Title of the file picker. {0} = game name.

data.comment: File type in the file picker. {0} = the extensions ("*.jpg;*.png"), keep it as is.

data.name: FilterPrograms
data.comment: File type in the file picker. {0} = "*.exe", keep it as is.

data.comment: Card title: which program the app watches to know when the game is running and when it closed.

data.name: ChangeProcess
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the button that changes the process to watch.

data.name: UseAutoDetect
data.comment: Menu item: go back to finding the game's program automatically.

data.name: ProcessAutoFolder

data.comment: State of the "Process to watch" card: any program started from the game's folder counts.

data.name: ProcessAuto
data.comment: State of the "Process to watch" card when there's no install folder.

data.name: PickProcessTitle

data.comment: Tooltip of the Reset button.

data.name: StartWith

data.name: SourcePathsDefault
data.comment: Second line of the SourcePaths card when nothing was changed.

data.name: EntrySteamFolder
data.comment: Label of a text box: the folder Steam is installed in.

data.name: EntrySteamArtFolder
data.comment: Label of a text box: the folder where Steam keeps game pictures.

data.name: EntrySteamCoverFiles
data.comment: Label of a text box: picture file names, separated by commas, tried one after another.

data.name: EntrySteamBannerFile
data.comment: Label of a text box: the file name of a game's wide banner picture.

data.name: EntrySteamLogoFile
data.comment: Label of a text box: the file name of a game's logo picture.

data.name: EntrySteamDownload
data.comment: Label of a text box: the web address game pictures are downloaded from.

data.name: EntryEpicManifests
data.comment: Label of a text box: the folder where the Epic Games Launcher keeps its list of installed games.

data.name: EntryGamesKey
data.comment: Label of a text box: the Windows registry key that lists the launcher's games.

data.name: EntryInstallsKey
data.comment: Label of a text box: the Windows registry key that lists installed games (Ubisoft Connect).

data.name: EntryLauncherKey
data.comment: Label of a text box: the Windows registry key of the launcher itself.

data.name: InvalidFolder
data.value: Enter the full path of a folder on this PC.
data.comment: Error under a folder text box: the value isn't a full path to an existing local folder.

data.name: InvalidRegistryKey
data.value: Enter a key under HKLM\SOFTWARE or HKCU\Software.
data.comment: Error under a registry key text box. Keep HKLM\SOFTWARE and HKCU\Software as they are.

data.name: InvalidFileName
data.value: Enter one file name ending in .jpg, .jpeg or .png, without a folder.
data.comment: Error under a file name text box.

data.name: InvalidFileNames
data.value: Enter up to 5 file names ending in .jpg, .jpeg or .png, separated by commas.
data.comment: Error under the cover file names text box.

data.name: InvalidAddress
data.value: Enter an https:// address with {appid} in it.
data.comment: Error under the download address text box. Keep https:// and {appid} exactly as they are (not placeholders to fill in).

data.name: DownloadHostNotice
data.value: Game Shelf will download pictures from {0}
data.comment: Note under the download address when it points to another site. {0} is the site's host name, e.g. cdn.example.com.

data.name: ResetEntry
data.comment: Button next to one text box that goes back to the default value. A verb.

data.name: ResetEntryName
data.comment: Screen reader name of the ResetEntry button. {0} is the text box's label, e.g. "Steam folder".

data.name: ResetAll
data.comment: Button that sets every entry back to its default. A verb.

data.name: CheckSource
data.comment: Button that reads one launcher's games once with the current values and shows what it found. A verb.

data.name: CheckSourceName
data.comment: Screen reader name of the CheckSource button. {0} is a launcher's name, e.g. "Steam".

data.name: CheckFoundOne
data.comment: Check result. {0} is the count (1).

data.name: CheckFound
data.comment: Check result. {0} is the number of games found.

data.name: CheckSteamArt
data.value: covers for {0} · banners for {1} · logos for {2}
data.comment: Check result for Steam, after "Found N games": how many games have each kind of picture on this PC: {0} covers, {1} banners, {2} logos (numbers). Lower case; keep the middle dots.

data.name: EntryNotFound
data.comment: Check result when an entry points nowhere. {0} is the entry's label, e.g. "Artwork folder".

data.name: InfoHowItWorks
data.comment: Heading at the top of Settings › Advanced, next to an (i) button; also that button's screen reader name and the title of the tip it opens.

data.name: InfoAbout
data.comment: Screen reader name and tooltip of the (i) button next to an entry. {0} is the entry's label, e.g. "Steam folder".

data.name: HelpSourcePaths1
data.value: Each box shows its default in grey. Leave it empty to keep using the default.
data.comment: First paragraph of the "How this works" tip in Settings › Advanced.

data.name: HelpSourcePaths2
data.value: Type a new value, then press Enter or leave the box to save it. A value that can't be used says why and isn't saved.
data.comment: Second paragraph of the "How this works" tip.

data.name: HelpSourcePaths3
data.value: New values are used from the next refresh (F5) or start. Check tries them right away and downloads nothing.
data.comment: Third paragraph of the "How this works" tip. F5 is the refresh key; Check is the CheckSource button.

data.name: HelpSourcePaths4
data.value: Reset goes back to the default. Pictures already on this PC stay.
data.comment: Fourth paragraph of the "How this works" tip. Reset is the ResetEntry button.

data.name: HelpSteamFolder
data.value: The folder Steam is installed in, the one with steam.exe. By default it's read from Steam's own registry entry. Example: D:\Steam
data.comment: Help for the "Steam folder" entry. Keep steam.exe and the example path as they are.

data.name: HelpSteamArtFolder
data.value: Where Steam keeps game pictures on this PC. By default the appcache\librarycache folder in the Steam folder. Example: D:\Steam\appcache\librarycache
data.comment: Help for the "Artwork folder" entry. Keep the folder names and the example path as they are.

data.name: HelpSteamCoverFiles
data.value: The portrait cover's file names, separated by commas and tried in order. The first is also the one downloaded when no cover is on this PC. Up to 5 names ending in .jpg, .jpeg or .png.
data.comment: Help for the "Cover file names" entry.

data.name: HelpSteamBannerFile
data.value: The file name of the wide banner behind Continue playing and in game details. One name ending in .jpg, .jpeg or .png, without a folder.
data.comment: Help for the "Banner file name" entry. "Continue playing" is the shelf's top card.

data.name: HelpSteamLogoFile
data.value: The file name of the game's transparent logo, shown on banners instead of its name. One name ending in .jpg, .jpeg or .png, without a folder.
data.comment: Help for the "Logo file name" entry.

data.name: HelpSteamDownload
data.value: Where pictures that aren't on this PC are downloaded from, once each. It must start with https:// and contain {appid}, which becomes the game's Steam number; {file} becomes the file name. Example: https://cdn.example.com/apps/{appid}/{file}
data.comment: Help for the "Download address" entry. Keep https://, {appid}, {file} and the example address exactly as they are (they are not placeholders filled in by the app here).

data.name: HelpEpicManifests
data.value: The folder where the Epic Games Launcher lists installed games, one .item file per game.
data.comment: Help for the Epic "Manifests folder" entry. Keep .item as it is.

data.name: HelpGogKey
data.value: The registry key where GOG lists installed games, one subkey per game. It must be under HKLM\SOFTWARE or HKCU\Software and is only read.
data.comment: Help for the GOG "Games registry key" entry. Keep HKLM\SOFTWARE and HKCU\Software as they are.

data.name: HelpUbisoftKey
data.value: The registry key where Ubisoft Connect lists installed games, one subkey per game. It must be under HKLM\SOFTWARE or HKCU\Software and is only read.
data.comment: Help for the Ubisoft "Installs registry key" entry. Keep HKLM\SOFTWARE and HKCU\Software as they are.

data.name: HelpRockstarKey
data.value: The Rockstar Games Launcher's registry key; its InstallFolder value says where Launcher.exe is. It must be under HKLM\SOFTWARE or HKCU\Software and is only read.
data.comment: Help for the Rockstar "Launcher registry key" entry. Keep InstallFolder, Launcher.exe, HKLM\SOFTWARE and HKCU\Software as they are.

data.name: RestartOnCrash
data.comment: Title of a per-game setting card with an on/off switch in Game detail, also the switch's screen-reader name. "it" = the game.

data.name: RestartOnCrashToolTip
data.value: Starts the game again after a crash, at most twice in a row
data.comment: Tooltip of the "Restart if it crashes" card. One short line.

data.name: RestartPillTitle
data.comment: Bold start of a one-line pill near the taskbar after a game crashed. {0} = the game's name. Very short; "crashed" is a verb (past tense).

data.name: RestartPillDetail
data.comment: After RestartPillTitle and a dot in the same pill, counting down. {0} = seconds left (5 to 1); "s" = seconds. Very short.

data.name: RestartCancelName
data.comment: Screen-reader name and tooltip of the Cancel button in that pill: the game is not started again.

data.name: RestartLimit
data.value: Restarted twice already, so Game Shelf stopped trying.
data.comment: Extra line on the crash card when the game crashed a third time in a row with "Restart if it crashes" on. Keep "Game Shelf" as is.
